shots.text: His army was spent. So he came out himself.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The citadel's gate opening. A tall figure in black armour under a crown of six empty sockets walks out alone onto the road.

shots.text: Six of you. Always six. Ask them what they did at my table.
shots.speaker: vael_orrun
shots.art_note: Vael-Orrun looking past the army at the six Wardens; cracks in his armour bleeding red, then blue, then green.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The six Wardens, silent. Thalassa alone meets his eyes.
